note: Wyndlewood props kit (props crew): Chapter One quest objects, landmarks and housing furniture. Each entry runs through scripts/asset_pipeline (Tripo text-to-image concept, then the prop lane image-to-model, normalize, preview). A `sheet` entry is ONE generation of several separate small objects, split afterwards into one GLB per part (tmp/props_kit/split.mjs) so small pieces cost a fraction of a model each. Ids are generic model ids and carry no player-visible names; the shipped GLB is public/models/props/wyn_<id>.glb.
